`Reminder: If you know which team will be responsible for this issue, add the label for that team.`

**Description:** What feature request or non-bug changes are you suggesting? Describe the intended behavior, reasoning for why it would be a good change, and things that need to be considered. Include relevant material like links to Canvas assignment writeups, existing issues, meeting dates where it was discussed, etc. Detailed is good, but keep straightforward.

**Subtasks:** List of relevant subtasks (as issue numbers)
- [ ] #x
- [ ] #y

**Status:** Does it pass our definition of done?
- [ ] Pass HTML and CSS validators
- [ ] Pass end-to-end automation
- [ ] Follow the style guides
- [ ] Reviewed by group
- [ ] Checked off by DevOps
- [ ] Specified behaviors are met (*expand on this list per issue*)
  - [ ] Specified behavior 1
